Zainub Ka Baba Logoon Dunia Se Jaraha Hai

Tarpe hai Qabra-e-Ahmad, Har Koi Roo Raha hai

mola nay waqat-e-ruksat abbas say kaha tha

zainab ki iss rida ka, Aik tu hi asra hai

Hasnain pay yatimi kofay main Aa gai hai

bintay ali kay sar say haye saya uth raha hai

kabay ka yeh makin hai damad-e-mustafa hai

mara hai kalma go nay kaba gira diya hai

dobi hoi zehar main jo tegh chal gai hai

mola hasan ka ro ro dil tokray ho raha hai

Matam hai murtaza ka jibriyal noha khwan hai

pursa ali wali ka bhola bhi parh raha hai

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/zainab-ka-baba-logon-duniya-se-ja-raha-hai.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
_, metadata, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].strip()
assert [s.strip().casefold() for s in roman.splitlines() if s.strip() and not s.strip().isdigit()] == [s.strip().casefold() for s in old.splitlines() if s.strip()]
for edition in (roman, body.strip()):
    blocks = edition.split('\\n\\n')
    assert [len(b.splitlines()) for b in blocks] == [2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3]
print('Verified all 12 Roman verses and matching Urdu stanza structure.')
PY"
